method: Compare image content after affine feature alignment; review ambiguous crops, mirrors and redraws. Retain visibly changed illustrations.

retained.reason: Possible small clothing/detail edits cannot be confidently excluded at sheet resolution; keep.
Foxfire Ahri: character pose, head and tails drawn differently.
Little Knight Amumu: entirely different scene and armor pose.
Sad Robot Amumu: same scene concept but face, eyes, body and foot redrawn.
Amumu supprimé et autre personnage ajouté au premier plan de la scène commune.
Red Riding Annie: Annie and Tibbers redrawn, different poses and background.
Frostfire Annie: new composition and character designs.
Hextech Annie: different running pose, clothing and character rendering.
Freljord Ashe: different costume, hair, bow and pose.
Queen Ashe: WR is shared throne room illustration with Tryndamere; PC outdoor solo scene.
Boom Boom Blitzcrank: completely different composition and robot design.
Visage/corps de Brand redessinés, flammes retouchées.
Visage, casque et détails de costume redessinés ; vu en taille source.
Rifle shape and colored details visibly differ.
Arcane Commander Caitlyn: WR is ensemble artwork, PC is separate solo illustration.
Urfrider Corki: character, mount, pose and action redrawn.
Bioforge Darius: similar pose but armor, shoulder, face and background visibly redrawn.
Costume de Diana couvrant le torse et lame retouchée.
Upper torso clothing coverage differs.
Personnage/victime du premier plan supprimé dans la version WR.
Soul Reaver Draven: different pose and framing of blades and body.
Face/hair details appear subtly different after reframing; uncertain, keep.
Hip and torso clothing coverage changed.
Possible neckline/torso detail edit cannot be confidently excluded; keep.
Poker chips replaced with gold coins.
Bras/avant-bras et proportions de Fizz modifiés.
Cravate supprimée, chemise et visage retouchés.
Dreadknight Garen: different costume and stance.
Vandal Gragas: PC at barrel, WR riding motorcycle.
Cigar and smoke removed.
Mouth/hand prop and nearby details repainted.
Veste, col et poignets de Heimerdinger retouchés.
Torso clothing coverage changed.
Tempest Janna: different costume, pose and staff design.
Red inset added at neckline.
Commando Jarvan IV: same scene concept but armor and weapon redrawn.
Warring Kingdoms Jarvan IV: character, armor, horse and weapon pose redrawn.
Classic Jax: different character design, stance and lantern.
Personnage et composition identiques, mais effets magiques rouges recolorés en violet ; à arbitrer si cette recoloration constitue une illustration distincte.
Arcane Survivor Jayce: WR ensemble artwork differs from PC solo illustration.
Possible clothing/shading edits cannot be confidently resolved; keep.
Prestige Battle Cat Jinx: completely different pose and composition.
Harbinger Kassadin: character and weapon pose redrawn.

Classic Leona: different character rendering, pose and background.

Petals of Spring Lillia: clearly different pose and scene.

Sorceress Lux: character pose, costume and location redrawn.
Steel Legion Lux: completely different pose and scene.
Obsidian Malphite: completely different creature design and pose.

Classic Nocturne: pose similar but shoulder armor and blade/body details redrawn.
Brolaf: different pose and scene.
